title: Ray (X4: Foundations)
intro: The Ray is a large Boron destroyer from the Kingdom End expansion, flown from the captain's chair. Forward guns, where fitted, fire on the trigger, and the turrets fire on their own; JoyPro has not checked its weapons.

panels.name: Ray: seat and weapons
panels.text: Facts about the Ray that set it apart from other X4 ships: where the pilot sits and which guns, turrets and docking it has.
panels.context: All other controls of the Ray are the shared X4 controls of this guide.

controls.name: Captain's chair (bridge)
controls.text: The Ray is a big ship, so the pilot flies it from the captain's chair on the bridge instead of a small cockpit. The stick controls are the same as in a fighter.
controls.context: A big ship like the Ray turns and speeds up slowly; the pilot plans moves earlier than in a fighter.

controls.name: Forward guns
controls.text: The Ray has where forward guns that point where the nose points. The pilot fires them with the trigger and aims by turning the whole ship.
controls.context: The aiming mark in front of the target on the HUD shows where to point the nose.

controls.name: Turrets
controls.text: The Ray carries turrets, gun mounts that turn and fire on their own without the pilot.
controls.context: Their behaviour is set in the menus; JoyPro has not checked how many the ship has.

controls.name: Ship class
controls.text: X4 sorts ships by size: S (small), M (medium), L (large) and XL (extra large). The Ray is: Boron L-class destroyer; armament not checked.
controls.context: The size decides whether the ship is flown from a cockpit or a bridge and where it can dock.
